body: Looking at your project it occurs you are having a circular reference. Your scene tries to resolve the reference to your Resource (`my_variable`), and the resource then tries to resolve the scene reference (`scene_of_item`). This results in godot giving up when trying to open up the file which i can understand can be annoying, especially because the errors in the Output are not immediately making clear what the problem is. Since circular dependencies are not easily resolved and would require a rework of the back end of Godot other measures to prevent these circular dependencies from happening should be taken and apparently they have been already, just that they are incomplete. When first setting the resource reference in the scene (`my_variable = sword.tres`), and only after that trying to reference the scene in the resource (`scene_of_item= sword_static_body.tscn`) godot prevents that your from assigning the scene, displaying a warning. So it would be a good thing to extend these recursion checks on field assignment to nodes, not just resources, to be save from both sides. (I hope im not forgetting something and there is a third case where you have to account for infinite recursion.) I have found that #84037 mentions this issue already, although I think it failed to correctly identify that the same thing that prevents recursive Resource references also prevents recursive references with PackedScene's, but again, only form the side of resources, not on the other end. The argument then drifts off into wanting to allow circular references (references [godot-proposals#7363](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/7363)) but doesn't go any further. I think it would be useful looking into if and how the recursion warning on assigning export variables can be implemented in PackedScenes, this way we don't have to wait for a 3 year old dead proposal (although I agree with [warent](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/84037#issuecomment-1782243062), circular references would be quite cool c:)

sorry, I think I haven't made this clear enough. 
While the general issue has been mentioned before in #84036, the diagnosis that PackedScene is missing a warning for recursive references is new.
I don't know if marking this as a duplicate of #7363 is right, because that issue has already pivoted to being a reason to add circular dependencies (#80877) and a closure of that issue only really makes sense anymore with the introduction of cyclic dependencies, while this issue could still be closed at the hands of a warning on assignment.

The warning is there and might be broken, that is tracked in:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109771
